title: LLMSQL: Upgrading WikiSQL for the LLM Era of Text-to-SQL
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW)
authors_zh: Dzmitry Pihulski, Karol Charchut, Viktoria Novogrodskaia, Jan Kocoń
paper_type_zh: 清洗并可执行验证的单表 Text-to-SQL 基准
best_for_zh: 需要现代 Text-to-SQL 单表基线或数据清洗范式的研究者。
one_line: LLMSQL repairs and re-releases WikiSQL as complete SQL records scored by executable SQLite result sets.
LLMSQL 修复并重发布 WikiSQL 为完整 SQL 记录，再以可执行的 SQLite 结果集合评分。
why: It makes a legacy Text-to-SQL dataset usable for modern full-SQL generation while preserving programmatic checking.
inclusion_reason: LLMSQL provides cleaned, executable Text-to-SQL records with SQLite result-set verification.

title: Problem
问题
html: WikiSQL was designed for early pointer networks and contains case inconsistencies, type errors, SQL syntax problems, unanswered questions, and token-selection labels. When modern LLMs generate complete SQL, these defects confound dataset errors with model errors. LLMSQL systematically classifies, cleans, and re-annotates WikiSQL, converts questions and full SQL into plain text, and provides a unified execution-evaluation package so the legacy corpus can serve modern generators.
WikiSQL 为早期 pointer-network 设计，存在大小写不一致、类型错误、SQL 语法问题、无答案问题和依赖 token 选择的标签格式；现代 LLM 直接生成完整 SQL 时，这些缺陷会把数据错误误判为模型错误。LLMSQL 对 WikiSQL 进行系统分类、自动清洗和重标注，将问题与完整 SQL 都转成普通文本，并提供统一执行评测包，使旧数据可用于现代生成模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LLMSQL is a cleaned WikiSQL benchmark of about 80.3K records, not a newly collected database corpus. It detects case-sensitivity issues, column-type mismatches, value errors, invalid SQL, and questions without executable answers, automatically repairing deterministic defects and removing or re-annotating unreliable cases. Each LLM-oriented record provides a natural-language question, schema/table, and full SQL text, while the official Python package standardizes Transformers/vLLM inference and execution accuracy.

LLMSQL 是约 80.3K 条记录的清洗版 WikiSQL benchmark，而非重新采集数据库。作者检测 case sensitivity、列类型、值匹配、非法 SQL 和无可执行答案等问题，自动修复可确定错误，对无法可靠修复的样本删除或重新标注，并保留 SQLite 表用于 execution accuracy。每条记录面向 LLM 提供自然语言问题、schema/table 与完整 SQL 文本；官方 Python 包统一 Transformers/vLLM 推理和执行评分。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Audit WikiSQL: Classify and quantify case, type, syntax, value, and no-answer errors.
  1. Clean automatically: Normalize tables and values, repair deterministic SQL, and execute it in SQLite; remove records that cannot be uniquely fixed.
  1. Convert formats: Expand pointer-network action labels into complete SQL text paired with questions and schemas.
  1. Standardize evaluation: Execute generated SQL on the corresponding table and compare result sets. Reproduction must fix the LLMSQL version, SQLite, few-shot examples, backend, and decoding settings because vLLM and Transformers can differ even at temperature zero.

1. 审计 WikiSQL： 分类统计大小写、类型、语法、值和无答案错误。
  1. 自动清洗： 规范表和值，修正可确定 SQL，并在 SQLite 上执行验证；无法唯一修复的记录移除。
  1. 转换格式： 将 pointer-network action 标签展开为完整 SQL 文本，配套问题和 schema。
  1. 统一评测： 模型生成 SQL 后在对应表上执行，按结果集合判断 correctness。复现需固定 LLMSQL 版本、SQLite、few-shot、backend 与解码参数，因为 vLLM/Transformers 即使 temperature=0 也可能不同。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper and current project evaluate multiple open and proprietary LLMs by execution accuracy, showing that the cleaned data consistently separates model scales and few-shot settings; current unified leaderboards place strong models above 90% while small models are much lower. More important is the error audit: original WikiSQL contains systematic defects that make correct SQL fail or incorrect SQL appear valid, while cleaning aligns labels with executable oracles. Because the leaderboard evolves, scores must be tied to dates and inference backends.

论文和当前项目对多种开源与闭源 LLM 进行 execution accuracy 评测，显示清洗后数据能够稳定区分模型规模和 few-shot 设置；当前统一 leaderboard 中较强模型可超过 90%，小模型则明显较低。更关键的证据来自错误审计：原 WikiSQL 中存在会导致正确 SQL 失败或错误 SQL 通过的系统性问题，清洗后可执行 oracle 与标签更一致。由于 leaderboard 持续更新，具体分数必须绑定日期和 backend。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier WikiSQL improvements usually change models or add schema linking while assuming the labels are reliable. LLMSQL treats the legacy benchmark itself as an artifact requiring reconstruction: it defines error classes, repairs them automatically, and converts specialized action representations into full SQL. It introduces no new Text-to-SQL architecture, instead providing LLM-ready data and a reproducible execution harness.
此前 WikiSQL 改进工作多更换模型或添加 schema linking，而默认数据标签可靠。LLMSQL 的新意是把旧 benchmark 本身视为需要工程重构的 artifact：系统定义错误类型、自动修复并把专用 action 表示转换为完整 SQL。它不提出新的 Text-to-SQL 架构，而是提供 LLM-ready 数据和可复现 execution harness。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Inherited WikiSQL simplicity: Single-table queries and small schemas remain far from real enterprise databases.
  1. Automatic-repair risk: Some questions allow multiple interpretations, and rule-based fixes may alter intent; change logs and manual audits are needed.
  1. Execution-equivalence boundary: Incorrect SQL may produce the same result on a particular sparse table. Multiple database instances or structural checks are needed to reduce accidental equivalence.

1. 继承 WikiSQL 简单性： 单表查询和较小 schema 仍与真实企业数据库有明显差距。
  1. 自动修复风险： 某些问题可能有多个合理解释，规则修复可能改变原意；应保留变更日志和人工抽检。
  1. 执行等价边界： 在当前表上结果相同的错误 SQL 可能被接受，尤其数据稀疏时；需要多数据库实例或结构检查降低偶然等价。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Modern Text-to-SQL baseline: Train or evaluate decoder-only LLMs directly on full SQL text.
  1. Data-cleaning reference: Reuse the error taxonomy and SQLite execution pipeline to audit other legacy SQL corpora.
  1. Reproducible comparison: Use the official llmsql package with fixed backend, few-shot, and execution accuracy. For multi-table, dynamic, or interactive databases, a harder benchmark is needed; high LLMSQL scores should not be extrapolated to real database agents.

1. 现代 Text-to-SQL 基线： 直接用完整 SQL 文本训练或评测 decoder-only LLM。
  1. 数据清洗参考： 复用错误分类和 SQLite 执行流程审计其他旧 SQL 数据。
  1. 可复现比较： 使用官方 llmsql 包固定 backend、few-shot 和 execution accuracy。若目标是多表、动态数据库或交互式 SQL，应选择更复杂 benchmark，不能把 LLMSQL 高分外推到真实数据库 agent。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: LLMSQL cleans about 80.3K WikiSQL records and converts them into full SQL suitable for modern LLMs.
  2. Method takeaway: Error taxonomy, rule repair, SQLite execution, and action-to-SQL conversion.
  3. Data takeaway: Questions, single-table schemas, full SQL, and database files are released together.
  4. Evidence anchor: Cleaning removes systematic label errors, and current strong models exceed 90% execution accuracy.
  5. Reuse decision: It is a useful single-table baseline, with accidental equivalence on sparse tables requiring audit.

1. 一句话定位： LLMSQL 将约 80.3K 条 WikiSQL 清洗并转换为现代 LLM 可直接生成的完整 SQL。
  2. 方法抓手： 错误分类、规则修复、SQLite 执行验证和 action-to-SQL 转换。
  3. 数据抓手： 问题、单表 schema、完整 SQL 和数据库文件共同发布。
  4. 证据锚点： 清洗消除系统性标签错误，当前强模型 execution accuracy 可超过 90%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合单表基线；必须防止稀疏表上的偶然执行等价。
